name: Inflation: The 34th NBER-TCER-CEPR TRIO Conference
organizer: NBER, Tokyo Center for Economic Research (TCER) and CEPR; supported by CARF, University of Tokyo
deadline_note: Stated as "11:59pm Eastern time on November 20, 2026" (NBER call, for North America-based authors)
submission_requirements: Preference to completed papers and detailed drafts. Only authors based in North America submit via the NBER link; the submitting co-author is expected to present. CARF covers travel and hotel for one North America-based author per paper.
journal: Papers may be submitted to a special issue of the Journal of the Japanese and International Economies (JJIE); JPY 200,000 honorarium if published
